arStrings.szText: {c_important}Umbral Chains{/c} explodes for {c_number}{payload:CHAIN_BURST_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage when stretched to its maximum or when it expires. If this happens early then any damage the chain would have done is added.

{c_important}Umbral Chains{/c} now always creates a chain link back to you. Additionally, a chain is created between you and each {c_important}Greater Demon Summon{/c} for up to {c_number}{SF_23}{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Umbral Chains{/c} becomes a {c_important}Hellfire{/c} Skill and whips around your target, dealing {c_number}{payload:CHAIN_WHIP_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage per second to surrounding enemies and striking a {c_number}[{SF_32}*100|%|]{/c} larger area when empowered by {c_important}{u}Volatility{/u}{/c}.

{c_important}Umbral Chains{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_22}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage when an unchained enemy is first caught by the chain. {c_important}{u}Hexed{/u}{/c} enemies always take increased damage.
When {c_important}Umbral Chains{/c} ends it refunds {c_number}{SF_17}{/c} Wrath for every enemy hit over its duration.
{c_important}Umbral Chains{/c} flies {c_number}[{SF_21}*100|%|]{/c} farther and its Slow is increased to {c_number}[{SF_20}*100|%|]{/c}.
{c_important}Umbral Chains{/c} Knocks Back your primary target and deals {c_number}[{SF_19}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage to them.
